import subprocess,json,pathlib,shutil
for label,cwd in [('candidate','/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex')]:
 print('Building',label,flush=True)
 result=subprocess.run(['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--release','--test','ingestion_publication','--locked','--no-run','--message-format=json'],cwd=cwd,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 pathlib.Path('/tmp/logex-canonical-reference-build-'+label+'.log').write_text(result.stderr)
 if result.returncode: raise RuntimeError(result.stderr)
 matches=[json.loads(line)['executable'] for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if json.loads(line).get('executable') and json.loads(line).get('target',{}).get('name')=='ingestion_publication']
 assert len(matches)==1,matches
 shutil.copy2(matches[0],'/tmp/logex-canonical-reference-'+label+'-bench')
 print(label,'built',flush=True)
